5. Revenue / Billing / Tariff Data

Required for defensible P&L exposure, billing gap, collection efficiency, revenue target realization and customer-value analysis. The dashboard will no longer create a tariff proxy when this file is absent.

Adds event start/end, duration, cause, fault/load-shedding category, restoration and action-owner evidence for operational risk decisions.

7. Nomination / Market Schedule
